subject: Provisional VAT clearance & staged payment release (Riverside AI)
messages:
From: Marta Kovac <marta.kovac@riverside.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@riverside.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:14:00 +0100
Subject: Payment hold - VAT ID mismatch (PO 78432)

Hi Rohan,

Apologies for the blunt note first thing — our AP team has put PO 78432 on hold. The VAT ID on the invoice we received (invoice 20260601-RWD-DA783) does not match the VAT registration you provided in the portal (different country and format).

We need one of the following to release payment:
- A corrected invoice with the VAT ID that matches the company registration on our vendor record, OR
- A completed self-billing agreement (Riverside prefers to self-bill in certain cross-border flows) plus a copy of your VAT registration/certificate.

If you can confirm provisional acceptance of self-billing, we can do a staged release (50% immediate, remainder on delivery of the certificate). Otherwise payment will remain blocked until we receive corrected documentation.

Thanks — can you advise by EOD today?

Best,
Marta
Senior AP Analyst
Riverside AI
[Attachment: PO-78432.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Kovac <marta.kovac@riverside.ai>

Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:03:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Payment hold - VAT ID mismatch (PO 78432)

Hi Marta — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the trouble.

We can proceed with self-billing if that simplifies the flow. To keep things moving, Redwood can accept a provisional staged payment: 50% on your immediate approval of the self-bill setup and 50% once we receive the VAT certificate.

I've attached a completed copy of our self-bill onboarding form (we've already signed on our side). Can you confirm Riverside's preferred signer and whether AP needs an emailed confirmation or a signed PDF?

I'll loop Vanessa and Ben from our finance team to handle documentation and follow up on any required PO/invoice corrections.

Thanks —
Rohan
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: self-bill-form.pdf (application/pdf)]

Hi Marta / Riverside AP team,

Thanks for the note — Vanessa here (Finance, Redwood). Quick checklist so we have a consistent record for the staged release: 

1) Self-bill form (attached) — signed by Redwood on 2026-06-07.
2) PO 78432 — we confirm Redwood's invoice references the PO (see original).
3) Provisional payment request: 50% release on acceptance of the self-bill agreement; remaining 50% on receipt of VAT certificate or formal vendor registration proof.
4) Delivery mechanics: we will issue a self-billed invoice referencing PO 78432 and mark as 'Provisional - final on certificate'.

Action items for Riverside AP: please reply with the preferred signer name/email for the self-bill agreement and whether an e-signature via DocuSign is acceptable. If Riverside can accept an emailed signed PDF, we can proceed immediately.

Ben, Sergio — once Marta confirms signer, please stand by to push the invoice through the accounting system.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 09:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Payment hold - VAT ID mismatch (PO 78432)

Folks — thanks for the fast turnaround. Riverside is willing to accept the self-billing agreement on a provisional basis. Our conditions:

- We will sign the self-billing PDF and return it by EOD today (preferred).
- We can release 40% of the outstanding invoice on our side upon receipt of your signed self-bill form, with a second 60% tranche once we receive the VAT certificate or EU VAT registration extract (whichever arrives first).
- Please email the VAT certificate to finance@riverside.ai and reference invoice 20260601-RWD-DA783.

Note: AP asks that the file type for the certificate be PDF or JPG and that the company legal name match the vendor record ("Redwood Inference Ltd" as recorded in our system).

I will send the signed self-bill agreement shortly.

Best,
Marta
Riverside AI — Accounts Payable
[Attachment: signed-self-bill-Riverside.pdf (application/pdf)]
